text:
jordan: Quick heads-up — we're starting a canary rollout of the internal 'route-broker' API that centralizes route-matching + tenant quota enforcement. This will introduce a new negotiation header: `X-RI-Route-Broker` (structured JSON blob). Need to sync on SDK compatibility for py/go/ts.

anya: Thanks — is this a strict replacement for the existing `Route-Hint` header or additive/fallback?

jordan: Additive for now. Broker will be honored when present; if absent we'll fall back to legacy `Route-Hint`. Goal is transparent migration with opt-in canary first.

kai: Important: many clients currently set `Route-Hint` as a simple string. The broker header expects a small JSON like `\{"route":"/dedicated/pool-1","affinity":"session"\}`. We'll need thin parsing in SDKs + graceful fallback.

lina: SDK owners here — py/sdk currently normalizes header keys to lowercase. Will that break negotiation?

anya: It might. Proposal: SDKs should expose an opt-in toggle `enable_route_broker: bool` that, when true, sends both headers (broker + legacy) for 2 weeks, then we flip. Also emit a telemetry event `sdk.route_broker.sent` so console can show adoption.

sojung: Console/telemetry note: we need to map `sdk.route_broker.sent` to a new tile in the quota dashboard and tag traces so we can compare pre/post latency & quota hits. Can we include a tiny client id in broker payload to correlate? (non-sensitive)

jordan: Yes, include `client_id` (opaque) and `sdk_name` fields. Nothing PII. We'll update the tracing hook to index those.

kai: Rollout UX: do canary across 5% of traffic (dedicated capacity allowed), 2-week window, and auto-revert if quota violations spike > 5x baseline. How do SDKs opt into canary?

lina: We'll ship a minor patch to py/go/ts that adds `enable_route_broker` flag default false. Docs + changelog + migration guide. We'll coordinate semver bumps: py 1.8.0, go v0.12.0, ts 2.3.0.

anya: Also add a public diagnostic endpoint `GET /v1/route-broker/debug` (internal only) that echoes parsed header to help devs debug. Add example snippet in docs: 

```
# python example
headers = {
  "X-RI-Route-Broker": '{"route":"/dedicated/pool-1","client_id":"cli_123"}',
  "Route-Hint": "pool-1"
}
resp = client.generate(prompt, headers=headers)
```

sojung: Console ops: we'll need an ingestion mapping for the new telemetry, a migration flag in dashboard to toggle showing broker-adopted vs legacy. Plan: wire telemetry this week, UI tile next sprint.

jordan: Deploybot will push broker service canary 03:30 UTC tomorrow. @deploy-bot can you annotate the deploy with rollback conditions?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: route-broker v0.1-canary -> infra-canary. Rollback if 5xx rate increases by 2x OR tenant quota enforcement mismatch > 1% during first 30m.

lina: I'll open the SDK PRs after deploy signal. Suggest we add a short-lived feature-flag in serverside to force sending broker header for internal test apps.

anya: Sounds good. I'll draft the migration doc and include a checklist: opt-in flag, telemetry, docs, canary metrics, console tile.

jordan: Great — thanks everyone. Quick action items: lina PRs, sojung telemetry mapping, anya migration doc, kai define rollback thresholds in runbook. :thumbsup:

lina: ack :thumbsup:

kai: ack

(End)
